recordedFrom: Read on 2026-09-28, read-only, from the production host: the project's run ledger (.openscience/runs.jsonl), its runtime ledger (.openscience/runtime.jsonl), the run's transcript (.openscience/transcripts/run_47071c383ffc….jsonl, completeness complete, 660 messages over the root and three child sessions) and the run-state mirror (.evimed-run/runs/native_83ed908fe037…/state.json). None of those files is copied here; this file states what they establish.

ledger.notice: delivery-receipt.json names deliverables/geo-insight/revision-notes.md with a digest the file no longer matches, and the package did not pass on the bytes now on disk

timeline.what: 「继续」 in the conversation bound to geo-insight 1.0.0, after the first attempt was cut by a release at 09:53:32Z (runtime_stopped).

Second submission accepted with its answers to the review's 23 findings: 82 claims (82 verified), 25 question groups, 88 measured questions, 5 control groups. The receipt records every file's sha256 at this moment.
Appended a section 「六、首轮审查之后改了什么」 to deliverables/geo-insight/revision-notes.md with a bash-run Python script, ran evimed_package_check (ok), and reported submitted:true without submitting again.
Delegated geo-strategy (steps 4–5) in the same conversation, before any baseline had been measured.
Package accepted (14 sources, 20 gaps, 5 engines, 3 tiers).

POST /api/session/cancel through the kernel frame (runtime ledger): the conversation was stopped because it was writing strategy before the baseline. The root's evimed_await and the strategy child's last evimed_submit_deliverable ended 'tool call aborted'.

Read the turn's end (aborted → canceled / runtime_canceled), found revision-notes.md no longer matching its receipt digest, and — because only a succeeded run is re-gated and amended on this path — recorded failed / specialist_receipt_digest_mismatch with no artifacts.

cause: The receipt is written over the final bytes only when a turn completes: run-policy's sealTurn → refreshReceipt runs on a `completed` turn end and not on an `aborted` one. A stopped turn therefore always leaves the receipt behind any file touched after the last acceptance.
The child touched an optional file (revision-notes.md) after its accepted submission; with the turn completing, that would have been re-digested and re-gated at the end and delivered.

The live finish path (agentRuns.mjs reconcileSession) handled a receipt mismatch on a non-succeeded run as tampering: it replaced the cancel with failed / specialist_receipt_digest_mismatch and dropped the four geo-insight files that still matched their digests.
notCauses: No release during the run: the runtime ledger shows the container started at 10:00:18Z and no exit before 10:31Z (the release that ended the first attempt was at 09:53:32Z).
Not geo_write: it writes the GEO tables in PostgreSQL, never a workspace file.
fixedBy: fix(runs): a run stopped after its files moved stays a stopped run (2026-09-28) — the same run now ends canceled / runtime_canceled with the matching files as its artifacts and revision-notes.md listed as unverified, and the notice says which file moved and that nothing judged it.

Already fixed on 2026-09-25 (“fix(geo): a conversation delegates only the first three steps; the platform schedules strategy, content and exports after it has measured” and “fix(geo): no strategy, tiers or 信源 step before the project has a finished baseline”): the reason the operator stopped this run.
stillNeeded: A geo-insight run that completes its turn. None of the production runs on record is one: this run was stopped, the first was cut by a release, and the later geo-insight packages that passed the gate (run_3fca60b67487, 10:42–10:59Z) were written in a session bound to geo-content and judged against geo-content's contract.
